findings.title: React 18 → 19 major version behind
findings.detail: package.json pinned react and react-dom to ^18.3.1; latest is 19.2.7 (one major behind). devDependencies @types/react@^18.3.12 and @types/react-dom@^18.3.1 were also behind. Fix was applied on branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-08-react-19: build passes and all 351 tests pass. PR creation failed — the GH_TOKEN fine-grained PAT lacks pull-requests:write permission. Branch is pushed; a human reviewer can open the PR manually.
findings.suggested_fix: Open a PR from branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-08-react-19 into main — all checks pass locally

findings.title: No build/test CI runs on direct pushes to main
findings.detail: The last 5 CI runs on main are all 'skipped'. They belong to the Claude Code workflow which only fires on PR comments/reviews. No workflow runs npm build or npm test on direct commits to main. The pr-checks.yml presumably covers PRs but merged commits are not re-verified.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a push-to-main trigger to pr-checks.yml or a dedicated ci.yml that runs npm install && npm run build && npm run test:run

findings.detail: git log --since='14 days ago' returned no changed source files. Missing-test audit is not applicable for this run.
